outcome: Incidence of childbirth pelvic floor trauma
finding: The review found that prenatal assessment of pelvis bone, spine curvature, perineal body and genital hiatus do not allow to predict the incidence of childbirth pelvic floor trauma, and that obesity and ethnicity are not risk factors for OASIS.
mod_finding: Performing a mediolateral episiotomy and applying fingers to the posterior perineum during the expulsive phase may reduce pelvic floor trauma.
